thesis: AI is dominated by pretrained Transformers whose capabilities are increasingly extended through reinforcement learning and inference-time reasoning. Models are becoming agents that use tools and perform real work, especially in software engineering, while compute, reliability and verifiability remain major constraints.

layers.paradigm: NVIDIA Blackwell-class fleets dominate, with inference capacity competing against training
layers.assumption: Frontier capability requires large accelerator clusters, with NVIDIA GPUs as the industry default.
frontier: TPU v6/v7 at frontier training scale
evidence: NVIDIA Blackwell GB200 rack-scale systems shipping — 2025
AMD MI325X/MI350 roadmap — 2024/2025
Anthropic multi-platform training across NVIDIA, TPU and Trainium — 2025
inference demand reported to rival training for accelerator capacity — 2025
grid interconnection queues named as a datacentre constraint — 2025

layers.paradigm: Transformers remain dominant, increasingly sparse/MoE and natively multimodal
layers.assumption: Transformer attention remains the architecture for frontier models; gains come from sparsity, scale and multimodality rather than from replacing attention.

distribution.basis: publicly known architecture family of frontier-scale models released 2024-2025; closed models do not disclose theirs, so this counts only what is known — every disclosed example is attention-based

evidence: DeepSeek-V3, 671B MoE with 37B active — 2024-12
Llama 4 MoE — 2025
Qwen3 MoE — 2025
Mamba/Jamba hybrids in production use — 2024/2025
diffusion language models demonstrated at small scale — 2025

layers.paradigm: Large-scale pretraining followed by capability-enhancing reinforcement learning and reasoning post-training
layers.assumption: Post-training with verifiable rewards can substantially improve reasoning in domains where outcomes can be checked automatically.
frontier: process reward models and step-level supervision
RL in non-verifiable and judgement domains
agentic RL over long tool-using trajectories
distillation of reasoning traces into small models
evidence: DeepSeek-R1, open reasoning model with published RL recipe — 2025-01
Gemini 2.5 with thinking budgets — 2025
Claude extended thinking — 2025-02
reasoning-trace distillation into small models widely reproduced — 2025

layers.paradigm: Curated, licensed and synthetic data supplement increasingly constrained public web data
layers.assumption: Further scaling cannot rely indefinitely on simply adding more high-quality public web text.
frontier: reasoning traces as a training corpus
evidence: Will We Run Out of Data? Villalobos et al., revised — 2024-06
major publisher and forum licensing agreements — 2024/2025
synthetic reasoning traces used to train open models — 2025
no defensible share data for this layer — distribution omitted

layers.paradigm: Training-time and inference-time compute are complementary scaling axes
layers.assumption: Capability can be improved both by training a stronger base model and by allocating more computation to reasoning at inference.
frontier: parallel sampling and search over reasoning traces
distillation of long reasoning into short inference
evidence: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally — 2024-08
o1 and o3 demonstrating inference-scaling curves — 2024/2025
reports of diminishing pretraining returns at frontier scale — 2024-11
no public source apportions frontier compute between pretraining and inference — distribution omitted

layers.paradigm: Million-token context with retrieval; weights still frozen after training
layers.assumption: Persistence remains external to model weights: context, retrieval, stored memory and agent state substitute for continual learning.
frontier: continual learning and post-deployment weight updates
evidence: Gemini 1.5/2.x 1M-2M token context — 2024/2025
Claude and GPT context windows at 200k+ — 2025
product-level persistent memory features shipped — 2025
context length is a property of the paradigm, not a share of it — distribution omitted

layers.paradigm: Chat remains the general interface, while autonomous coding agents establish tool-using AI as a new work interface
layers.assumption: The primary end-user interface for general AI is conversational chat.
evidence: Claude Code, Codex and agentic coding tools in wide use — 2025
computer-use agents released by multiple labs — 2024/2025
MCP published as a tool-interface standard — 2024-11
no public source apportions usage across chat, API, IDE and agents — distribution omitted

layers.paradigm: Frontier capability is expensive and concentrated, with rapidly improving open and low-cost alternatives behind it
layers.assumption: Training the best models requires capital and compute available to only a small number of organisations.
frontier: frontier-equivalent training at order-of-magnitude lower cost
small models matching prior frontier capability
evidence: DeepSeek-R1 open weights with published RL recipe — 2025-01
DeepSeek-V3 reported ~$5.6M training cost — 2024-12
sustained per-token price declines across providers — 2024/2025
Llama 4 and Qwen3 open weights — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Reliability
bottlenecks.problem: Reasoning gains are demonstrated only where an answer can be checked automatically. Whether they hold in domains that cannot be checked is unknown, and errors still compound over long runs.
evidence: o-series gains concentrated in mathematics, code and formal domains — 2024/2025
SWE-bench Verified — 2024-08
long-horizon agentic benchmarks far below human completion — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Compute cost and availability
bottlenecks.problem: Accelerator supply, packaging, memory bandwidth and grid interconnection bound frontier training, and inference now competes for the same capacity.
evidence: Blackwell rack-scale power and cooling requirements — 2025
CoWoS capacity named as the constraint — 2024/2025
grid interconnection queues for datacentre load — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Agency
bottlenecks.problem: Agents can perform useful work, but reliability deteriorates over long tasks and consequential actions still require supervision, limiting how much work can safely be delegated.
evidence: computer-use agents released with explicit caveats — 2024/2025
MCP published as a tool-interface standard — 2024-11
EU AI Act obligations phasing in — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Context and memory
bottlenecks.problem: Weights remain frozen after training. Context is enormous and memory features exist, but they store text rather than learning, so nothing accumulates.
evidence: million-token context shipped without continual learning — 2024/2025
product memory features are retrieval over stored text — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Data quality and supply
bottlenecks.problem: The supply of new high-quality public text is increasingly constrained, and synthetic and licensed data introduce their own questions about quality, cost and access.
evidence: Will We Run Out of Data?, revised — 2024-06
model-collapse results on recursive synthetic training — 2024-07
licensing replacing open crawling — 2024/2025

bottlenecks.name: Inference cost and latency
bottlenecks.problem: Per-token prices have collapsed, but reasoning models spend orders of magnitude more compute per answer, so the capable path is expensive and slow again.
evidence: inference-scaling curves published for o-series — 2024/2025
thinking budgets exposed as a user-facing cost control — 2025
inference demand reported to rival training for capacity — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Closed frontier
bottlenecks.problem: Open weights now reach frontier-adjacent capability, but the largest models still disclose neither their data nor their full training method.
evidence: DeepSeek-R1 published weights and RL recipe — 2025-01
Llama 4, Qwen3 open weights — 2025
closed frontier models undisclosed in data and method — 2025

bottlenecks.name: Customization
bottlenecks.problem: Adapting a model is easier than it was, but doing it well still means owning weights, and the best models cannot be adapted at all.
evidence: reasoning-trace distillation into small open models widely reproduced — 2025
fine-tuning still unavailable on the leading closed models — 2025
